        private static async Task<Results<NoContent, ProblemHttpResult>> HandleAsync(
            IFormFileCollection photos,
            ICommandMediator mediator,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var photosBytes = new List<byte[]>(photos.Count);
            foreach (var part in photos)
            {
                using var photosStream = new MemoryStream();
                await part.CopyToAsync(photosStream, cancellationToken);
                photosBytes.Add(photosStream.ToArray());
            }

            await mediator.SendAsync(
                new RetireCopyCommand(
                    Photos: photosBytes
                ),
                cancellationToken);

            return TypedResults.NoContent();
        }
    }
